ena_definition: Information is inappropriate to report, can indicate that the standard itself fails to model or represent the information appropriately
plain_meaning: This field doesn't make sense for this sample (host body site for a soil sample).

ena_definition: Information of an expected format was not given because it has not been collected
Information of an expected format was not given, a value may be given at the later stage
plain_meaning: The information exists or may exist, but isn't supplied now; it can be added later.

ena_definition: Information exists but can not be released openly because of privacy concerns
plain_meaning: It exists but can't be shared, for privacy reasons.

ena_definition: Information is not applicable as the sample represents a negative control sample collected in a lab.
plain_meaning: The sample is a negative control collected in the lab, so the field has no real value.

ena_definition: Information is not applicable as the sample represents a group of samples that do not have a single origin.
plain_meaning: The sample pools material from several origins, so there is no single value.

ena_definition: Information does not exist as the sample represents an ab-initio synthetic construct.
plain_meaning: The sample was made synthetically from scratch, so the information doesn't exist.

ena_definition: Information was not collected as the sample represents a cultured cell line or model organism under long-term lab control.
plain_meaning: The sample is a cell line or lab-kept organism, so the information wasn't collected.

ena_definition: Information does not exist as the metadata was not collected or reported in records predating the 2023 agreement.
plain_meaning: The sample comes from records made before 2023 that never held this information.

ena_definition: Data agreements were established before the 2023 INSDC standard and metadata can not be provided.
plain_meaning: A data agreement made before 2023 doesn't allow this information to be given.

ena_definition: Information can not be reported as the target organism is endangered e.g. on the IUCN red-list.
plain_meaning: The organism is endangered, so the information can't be published.

ena_definition: Information can not be reported as the metadata would make the sample human-identifiable.
plain_meaning: Giving the information would make it possible to identify a person.
